sloka: निहताः किङ्कराः सर्वे जम्बुमाली च राक्षसः ।अमात्यपुत्रा वीराश्च पञ्च सेनाग्रयायिनः ।। ५.४८.७।।।।
transliteration: nihatāḥ kiṅkarāḥ sarve jambumālī ca rākṣasaḥ ।amātyaputrā vīrāśca pañca senāgrayāyinaḥ ।। 5.48.7।।।।

translations.english: "All the kinkaras , Jambumali, the heroic demons, sons of the ministers and five army generals were slain. Battalions of well-equipped army including horses, elephants and chariots were also destroyed.
translations.hindi: तुम घमंज्ञ, कृतज्ञ, राजनीतिविशारद पूर्वापर के जानने वाले झौर प्राणियों में सबसे अधिक परमार्थतत्व के ज्ञाता हो
